text:
maria: Heads up — rate patch v3.1 deploys tomorrow 08:00 PT. Primary change: POC discounting moves from ad‑hoc approvals to scoped exceptions on the new rate card. Please read before you approve any deals.

sam: Quick q — what happens to active POCs that started this month? grandfathered or re-evaluated?

julia: Also need clarity on max allowed discount for sales-led POCs vs engineering trials. finance was vague.

kevin: TL;DR from deal desk: we can auto-approve up to 30% for POCs <90 days if sales attaches the POC checklist + SOC signoff. Anything >30% or >90d needs pricing & finance review. Use this form: https://redwood.internal/deals/exceptions 

maria: @kevin can we confirm whether legacy commits (pre-v3.1) keep their old slab? customers ask about commit credits mapping.

kevin: yes — existing committed deals are grandfathered to their existing rate_card_version unless sales explicitly elects to migrate. Migration path: run the migrate script and attach the migration note to the deal.

deal-desk-bot: Reminder: exception requests without the POC checklist will be auto-rejected. See checklist: https://redwood.internal/ops/poc-checklist (posted by deal-desk-bot)

ryan: For technical presales — does the new rule change how we price dedicated burst for POCs? IOW, can we still add burst capacity credits as a separate line item?

kevin: yes, burst stays separate. Pricing teams recommended listing burst as an add-on SKU; discount caps apply per-SKU.

sam: ok thanks. can we get a short copy to paste into emails? customers are asking.

anya: I can draft a customer-friendly blurb and a one‑pager for AMs. Will post by EOD. cc @julia for limits.

julia: will update the internal KB and add an FAQ entry about commit mapping + grandfathering. I'll flag the rollback criteria too: >5 escalations in 24h or <80% acceptance rate triggers a patch rollback.

maria: note — operations: deploy includes a telemetry gate. if tokenized billing anomalies > 15% for any customer cohort, we pause and announce.

sam: small nit — what's the canonical label we should put in CRM so deal desk picks up the version automatically?

maria: use label: rate_card:v3.1  (no spaces). sample update snippet for SFDC:```
PATCH /deals/12345
{ "custom_fields": { "rate_card_version": "v3.1" } }
```

kevin: action items: 1) deal desk triages exceptions in the new form (kevin) 2) sales one-pager (anya) 3) KB + FAQ (julia) 4) ops to monitor rollout (maria). I will monitor approvals today. :thumbsup:

ryan: thanks — I'll update the presales runbook with burst SKU guidance.

maria: if anyone runs into an edge case during sales calls, ping #release-war-room and include deal id + brief context. We'll handle fast-tracks there.

kevin: FYI — exceptions submitted before 08:00 PT will be reviewed under old policy; after deploy they go through new flow. plan accordingly.

anya: posting draft blurb in sales #templates in 30m.

sam: got it. appreciate the heads up.

julia: added FAQ stub, will iterate.

maria: closing loop — thanks team. will run a short 20-min Q&A tomorrow 09:00 PT for anyone who wants to join. calendar invite incoming. 🔁
